title: The Dual Alliance of 1879 is a defensive treaty between Austria-Hungary and Germany
summary: The 7 October 1879 Dual Alliance binds Austria-Hungary and Germany.
body: Avalon prints the Dual Alliance of 7 October 1879 between Austria-Hungary and Germany. It is a bilateral defensive treaty. It is not the later Triple Alliance text and not the Franco-Russian military convention. The wording on the page includes: "1700 - 1799 19th Century 1800 - 1899 20th Century 1900 - 1999 21st Century 2000 - The Dual Alliance Between Austria-Hungary and Germany - October 7, 1879 Art 1 Art 2 Art 3 Art 4 Art 5 ARTICLE 1.
